Waxing/Tinting/Bleaching
Waxing
An effective way to remove large amounts of hair at one time, waxing is the most hygienic and thorough method.  It removes hair and dead skin cells leaving smooth skin behind.  Re-growth is softer, finer, less irritating, and it will occur at a much slower rate.  You will look and feel years younger with our many waxing services.

Tinting
Your hair looks fabulous, but you feel something is missing.  Tinting may be the answer.  A completely safe alternative to make-up, it enhances your features by adding definition to your eyebrows and eyelashes.  You can expect results to last 4-6 weeks.
